title: Meridiani Planum
subtitle: Opportunity rover field site
summary: Opportunity found hematite-rich spherules and layered sandstone at Meridiani Planum. These deposits preserve evidence of liquid water in the Martian past.
whyGo: Inspect hematite-rich deposits and layered rocks to reconstruct past water and surface conditions.

image.alt: False-color orbital view of layered terrain and craters at Meridiani Planum
